title:
Privacy,
in plain sight.
narration: Shielded payments hide what matters. Public patterns still need context. Ostrakon makes the evidence readable, without a wallet key.

title:
Mainnet.
Inspectable.
narration: Real, recorded Zcash mainnet data. All seven transactions from this block, collected on October sixteenth.

title:
Evidence you
can inspect.
detail:
Tatum Zebra RPC
CipherScan comparison
Committed source records
narration: The source panel shows the network and collection time. CipherScan agreed on public fields. Responses and checksums are on GitHub. A snapshot, not live verification.

title:
Every record
has a reason.
narration: All seven records stay visible. One fits the comparison rule; six are excluded. Each exclusion has a reason.

title:
A payout.
Not a guess.
detail:
0.25015 ZEC pool outflow
= 0.25 ZEC public payout
+ 0.00015 ZEC fee
narration: A real Ironwood exit. A quarter of a ZEC goes to the public recipient. The fee explains the remaining outflow. Hidden note values stay hidden.

title:
A fee is not
a payment.
detail:
No transparent payout
No invented recipient
No anonymity verdict
narration: Here, only the fee contribution is public. There is no transparent payout. No matches does not prove privacy.

title:
A candidate.
Not a claim.
detail:
Amount + time heuristic
Visible supporting records
Ownership unproven
narration: Now, a clearly labeled synthetic example. The dashed line shows an amount and timing candidate. The records explain why. Ownership remains unproven.

title:
Change timing.
Keep context.
detail:
Original: 1 candidate
Hypothetical: 0
Original data unchanged
narration: Change the timing, and the candidate disappears. Your original data stays untouched. Fewer matches do not certify anonymity.

title:
Your data.
Your browser.
detail:
Browser worker analysis
No wallet keys or accounts
Local import + report export
narration: Analysis stays in your browser. No keys, accounts, or dataset uploads. Import a snapshot, inspect it, and export your report.
